title: o g d m c k
cando: read and write words with six more letters

about.text: In this lesson you learn the sounds o, g, d, m, c, k. You hear each sound, you write its letters, and then you read words and a short text with them.
goals: Say the sound each new letter makes
Join sounds together to read a word
Break a word into sounds to write it
Read the new words out loud

chapters.title: o g d
chapters.text:
This is Lesson 3. Three more letters.
First. o. Short and round. o.
Say it with me. o. o. o.
Next. g. At the back of your throat. g.
Say it with me. g. g. g.
Last. d. A tap behind your teeth. d.
Say it with me. d. d. d.
Careful with d. Look at its shape.
The circle first. Then the line.
That is d. Not b.
Now join them.
d. o. g. Dog.
Say it with me. d-o-g. Dog.
Another. g. o. t. Got.
And. d. a. d. Dad.
Listen to dad. The same sound at both ends.
Now count. How many sounds in dog?
d. o. g. Three.
Three sounds. Three letters. This time.
Later you will meet words where that changes.
Now three tricky words. Do. To. Go.
The words do and to rhyme. Go does not.
Learn all three by sight today.
Now try the sounds on and. a. n. d. And.
It works. The word and is not tricky. You can sound it out.

chapters.title: m c k
chapters.text:
Three more letters.
First. mmm. Close your lips and hum.
Say it with me. mmm. mmm.
Feel your lips touch. That is m.
Next. c. At the back of your mouth. c.
Say it with me. c. c. c.
Last. k. Listen carefully.
k. Say it with me. k. k.
Did you hear? c and k are the same sound.
Two letters. One sound.
That is normal in English. It is not a mistake.
Cat starts with c. Kit starts with k.
The sound is the same. The letter is not.
You will learn which one to use by reading.
Now join them.
c. a. t. Cat.
Say it with me. c-a-t. Cat.
Another. mmm. a. p. Map.
And. k. i. t. Kit.
Now three tricky words.
The first is old. The second is no. The third is so.
All three say oh, not the sound in dog.
Learn all three by sight today.
Now try the sounds on am. a. m. Am.
It works. The word am is not tricky. I am here.

sounds.about: A short round sound. o, as in on.
A sound made at the back of your throat. g.
A tap of the tongue behind your teeth. d.
A hum with your lips closed. mmm.
A short sound at the back of the mouth. c.
The same sound as c. k.

reader.title: Dad Got a Dog
reader.text:
Dad got a dog.
The dog is tan.
It sat on a tin.
Dad sat and the dog sat.
I got a pot and a pan.
Dad and I go on.

canDo: I can say the sounds o, g, d, m, c, k.
I can read words like dog and got.
I can write a word from its sounds.
I can read a short text out loud.
